_source.dataset: HUD Income Limits (area median income and 30/50/80 percent limits, household sizes 1-8)
_source.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Office of Policy Development and Research
_source.columns: il30 / il50 / il80 = arrays of 8 dollar limits for household sizes 1..8 (extremely low = 30%, very low = 50%, low = 80% of area median income, as HUD defines them)
_source.not_provided: The API has no 60% (LIHTC / MTSP) limit and no 120% limit; none is computed here.
